name: How to Maximize Your ADU's Rental Potential

step.name: Step 1: Prioritize Smart Design & Layout
step.text: Even smaller ADUs can feel spacious and functional with clever design. Think open-concept living areas, plenty of natural light, and efficient storage solutions. Consider built-in shelving or multi-functional furniture. A well-designed space in areas like Newport Beach or Mission Viejo will attract higher-quality tenants and command better rent.

step.name: Step 2: Invest in Quality Finishes & Appliances
step.text: While you don't need top-of-the-line everything, choosing durable, attractive finishes and reliable appliances makes a huge difference. Quartz countertops, easy-to-maintain flooring, and energy-efficient appliances are big draws. These not only appeal to tenants but also reduce maintenance costs for you down the line.

step.name: Step 3: Ensure Privacy and Outdoor Space
step.text: Tenants highly value privacy. Design your ADU with a separate entrance and, if possible, a small private outdoor area like a patio or deck. Even a small dedicated space can make the unit feel much more like a standalone home, increasing its perceived value.

step.name: Step 4: Consider Modern Amenities
step.text: Think about what tenants expect in a modern living space. This might include in-unit laundry, good internet connectivity, and adequate heating and cooling systems. These small touches can make your ADU stand out in a competitive rental market.

step.name: Step 5: Professional Management & Marketing
step.text: Once built, market your ADU effectively with professional photos and a clear, appealing description. Consider working with a property manager if you're not keen on handling tenant screenings, leases, and maintenance yourself. Affordable Home Remodeling can build you a great ADU, setting you up for rental success.
